title: Schools Reopened, But Homeschooling Stayed At 5.4%
hook: Schools reopened, yet homeschooling remained at 5.4%, nearly double its earlier share.
closing: Reopening classrooms did not restore the earlier pattern; families kept making different choices about where children learn.
question: What matters most when choosing a school?

segments.say: The later homeschooling share was 5.4%. It fell from the pandemic peak but remained nearly double its earlier level.
School environment or safety concerned 83% of homeschooling parents in this survey. It was a reported reason, not a measured cause.
Private schooling accounted for 9.6% in the supplied comparison. Homeschooling had grown substantially but still served a smaller share.
